newsitem.title: USA: Isis says cancer compounds appear safe.
newsitem.headline: Isis says cancer compounds appear safe.

text.p: Isis Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that Phase I clinical trials of two of its anti-cancer compounds are near completion and appear to demonstrate "safety and preliminary evidence of response in some patients."

The company said plans are under way to initiate Phase II trials for those compounds, ISIS 5332 and ISIS 3521, in the second half of this year. Both compounds are being tested on a variety of solid tumors.
It also said it plans to initiate Phase I trials for a third anti-tumor compoud, ISIS 2503, around mid-year.

And it said it expects to complete Phase III trials of ISIS 2922 (fomivirsen) later this year. Fomivirsen is a compound designed to treat CMV retinitis, a virus that often strikes late-stage AIDS patients and can lead to blindness.
